class.name: GodotDoctorJUnitXmlReportExporter
class.brief_description: Exports CLI validation results as a JUnit-style XML report.

method.name: _indent
method.description: Returns an indentation string for the given [param level].

method.name: export_report_from_suite_reports
method.description: Exports a JUnit-style XML report from [param suite_reports] if enabled in settings. [param summary_stats] is the [Dictionary] from the [GodotDoctorSummaryReport] stats used to populate top-level report attributes.

method.name: _ensure_directory_exists
method.description: Ensures the directory at [param dir_path] exists, creating it recursively if needed. Returns [code]true[/code] on success, [code]false[/code] on failure.

method.name: _build_junit_xml_report
method.description: Builds and returns the full JUnit XML report string from [param suite_reports].

method.name: _build_testsuite_xml
method.description: Builds and returns the XML string for a single [param suite_report].

method.name: _build_scene_testcase_xml
method.description: Builds and returns the XML string for a single [param scene_report] testcase. Uses [param treat_warnings_as_errors] to calculate effective failure counts.

method.name: _build_resource_testcase_xml
method.description: Builds and returns the XML string for a single [param resource_report] testcase. Uses [param treat_warnings_as_errors] to calculate effective failure counts.

method.name: _build_node_xml
method.description: Builds and returns the XML string for a single [param node_report]. Uses [param treat_warnings_as_errors] to calculate effective failure counts.

method.name: _build_resource_item_xml
method.description: Builds and returns the XML string for the resource item element within a resource testcase. Uses [param treat_warnings_as_errors] to calculate effective failure counts.

method.name: _build_message_xml
method.description: Builds and returns the XML string for a single validation [param message]. Uses [param treat_warnings_as_errors] to annotate promoted warnings.

method.name: _get_effective_error_count
method.description: Returns the effective error count from [param messages], counting warnings as errors when [param treat_warnings_as_errors] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: _basename
method.description: Returns the filename portion of [param path], without any leading directory components.

method.name: _xml_escape
method.description: Returns [param value] with XML special characters escaped.

method.name: _resolve_uid_path
method.description: Resolves a [code]uid://[/code] path to its corresponding resource file path. Returns [param path] unchanged if it is not a UID.

constants.constant: The default filename used for the XML report when none is specified in settings.
The number of spaces per indent level in the XML output.
The number of test items counted per resource (always 1, since each resource is a single item).
